column1: # Sonntag R.E. (1960). The Equilibrium of Solid Carbon Dioxide with its Vapor in the Presence of Nitrogen.
# PhD dissertation, University of Michigan (Industry Program report IP-469), October 1960; Deep Blue hdl 2027.42/7707.
# Local copy: sonntag-1960-dissertation-umich-bad2222.pdf (sha256 3b2709380b9bd87ce5a545fad1976a948b12093c77e461022c488c4992d7bd7c),
# a scan with no text layer. Table VIII, "Mole fraction of carbon dioxide as a function of temperature and pressure",
# printed page 100 (PDF page index 119, 0-based), read from a 200 dpi render.
# System: CO2 + N2, solid-vapour equilibrium (SVE, frost points). Solid phase: pure CO2 (N2 assumed negligible in the solid,
# not measured). y_CO2 = mole fraction of CO2 in the vapour. T = nominal isotherm, K; p = nominal equilibrium pressure, atm.
# 64 points (6 isotherms x 11 pressures, two blanks printed as "--": 190 K at 5 atm and 140 K at 100 atm).
# Uncertainty: per-point gas-analysis limits are in Table IX (not transcribed); the footnotes quote +-0.00002 to +-0.00003 in y
# near y = 0.002 to 0.003. Table VIII footnotes: 160 K 70 atm = average of .00334 +- .00002 and .00330 +- .00003;
# The same data were published as Sonntag and Van Wylen, Adv. Cryog. Eng. 7, 99 (1962), doi:10.1007/978-1-4757-0531-7_12
# (not in hand), and are the "EXP" enhancement factors of Smith, Sonntag, Van Wylen, Adv. Cryog. Eng. 8, 162 (1963), Table I
# (check: 140 K, 5 atm: 0.00042 x 5 / 0.00184 atm = 1.141 against the printed E = 1.1414).
# Smith 1963 (dissertation, Table XIII, file smith-1963-dissertation-table13-co2-n2-sve.tsv) re-measured 80 atm and up at
# 140 and 150 K and 60 atm and up at 190 K and found lower y there; he attributes the 190 K difference to a ~1 K warm bias in
# Sonntag's heat exchanger. Prefer Smith's values where the two overlap.
# p_MPa is derived here (atm x 0.101325), not printed.
# Sanity check: y_CO2 increases with T at every pressure; each isotherm has its minimum near 20 to 50 atm (enhancement).
# Digits as printed, one sanity check, not re-verified (owner: not looking for 100 % correct data).
# Role: G4 frost-point holdout. Transcribed 2026-09-25, batch 2026-09-24-coolprop-low-temperature.
